note: Owner decision 2026-11-19: the new pipeline reads its own copies of the five v0.5 wrappers. Each entry is the production wrapper the copy was taken from: SHA-256 of the file text with every CRLF read as LF (since slice 4 Task 5, 2026-11-23; before, of the raw bytes, which made a CRLF checkout look like a change) and its git blob id. The readings loader and stg_wrapper_drift compare the production file's current text hash with this value (table wrapper_drift).
